stem:
Preeti has an iron nail and a bar magnet that look similar when painted.

How can she tell which one is the magnet?

options.text: By seeing which one can repel the other; repulsion identifies a magnet.
By seeing attraction only; both can attract, so that test is enough.
Neither can be identified without a battery.

teacher.key_rationale: Attraction is not enough because iron is attracted too. Repulsion identifies a magnet. Paint and batteries are not the test.
